{{Quote|Stand by, ion control&hellip; Fire!|Toryn Farr|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Ion Cannon Control''', otherwise referred to as '''Hoth ion battery control'''<ref name="SW XWingAlliance">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]</ref> or simply '''ion control''', oversaw the operation and firing of the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Planetary ion cannon|ion cannon]] that protected the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="CCG-Toryn">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Toryn Farr}}</ref> Ion Cannon Control was staffed by twenty-seven personnel, all of which were [[Alderaanian/Legends|natives]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="GG3-2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'' (Second Edition)]]</ref> [[Communications officer/Legends|Chief Controller]] [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] was responsible for issuing firing orders to Ion Cannon Control.<ref name="CCG-Toryn" /> An Alliance [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot escorting the  ''[[Otana]]'', a [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], hailed ion control on the planet to fire upon two [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II-''class Star Destroyers]], including the ''[[Corrupter]]'', that obstructed the escape path for the [[Azzameen family|Azzameen]]-owned [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The  V-150 fired a pair blue ion bolts which intercepted the ''Corrupter'', hitting the bridge on its [[Conning tower/Legends|conning tower]] and the vessel's right [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]/[[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] globe, disabling the [[Capital ship/Legends|captal ship]].<ref name="SW XWingAlliance" /> The crew fought ferociously against invading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops attempting to seize the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]].<ref name="GG3-2" />
